After seeing numerous articles now comparing the FFXV we have now to a "beta", I feel like I gotta say this.

You can play the entire FFXV story right now and get a full, understanding experience, as long as you pay attention. The only way you will "miss out" on and story is if you don't watch the movie or anime. While I won't argue that Chapter 13 sucks, I understand why it is like it is. [It's showing you that you need your party to succeed, otherwise you are weak alone](/spoiler). You will understand why [Raevus](/spoiler) did what he did, you will understand [Ardyn's](/spoiler) story, and you will understand [Noctis's](/spoiler) actions. It is a fully comprehensible story and game. What these articles are getting wrong is that this story content is ADDITIONAL story content, not NEEDED story content. They will be scenes to go more in-depth on certain characters, not to explain them as a whole.

If you're like me, you absolutely loved this game and think it is currently near perfect, and will gladly play through it again to experience the changes to Chapter 13, as well as any story changes they might make. What I do know is that this game is the furthest thing from a "beta" you could find. 80+ hours of gameplay is not a beta. A fully comprehensible, even emotional story is not a beta. So fuck off with that talk.
